shortDescription: Two Federal Reserve governors met with or attended events hosted by private-sector banking officials in recent months during the central bank’s blackout periods, when such meetings are subject to restrictions, according to Bloomberg.

title: Fed Governors Attended Banker Events During Blackout Periods
